description: This test verifies the search functionality by ensuring users can search for specific products using keywords and navigate to product details.
steps: Navigate to the homepage at https://atid.store.
Locate and click on the 'Search' button in the header.
Type 'Yellow Shoes' into the search input field.
Submit the search query by pressing Enter.
Verify that the search results page displays products related to 'Yellow Shoes'.
Click on the product link for 'ATID Yellow Shoes' from the search results.
Verify that the product detail page for 'ATID Yellow Shoes' is displayed.
expected_results: Search results for 'Yellow Shoes' are displayed.
The product detail page for 'ATID Yellow Shoes' is displayed.
edge_cases: The search button is non-clickable or missing.
No products are displayed in the search results.
The product link in the search results is non-clickable.
The search results page fails to load.
Typing in the search input field does not work.
data_requirements: The product 'ATID Yellow Shoes' must exist in the database.
The search button must be present on the homepage.
Search indexing for products must be up-to-date.
Search results must link to product detail pages.
api_interactions: GET request to fetch search results for 'Yellow Shoes'.
performance_metrics: Load time for the product detail page.
accessibility_requirements: Search input field must have an accessible label.
Ensure the search button is keyboard-accessible.
Verify color contrast on the search results page.
